description: Watercolour Dinosaurs Panorama mural 1536x1024 (3:2): three friendly watercolour dinosaurs stand side by side in the lower-centre band — a dusty blue-grey long-necked Brachiosaurus on the left-centre, a warm sand-ochre Triceratops in the centre, and a muted sage-green Stegosaurus on the right-centre — set in a serene prehistoric valley with palm trees on the far left and far right, a pale blue lake, distant misty mountains, a gentle smoking volcano and soft pastel rainbow with a warm sun on the right, and a beige pterodactyl flying in the upper right-centre. Warm cream-sand background, dusty blue, muted sage, soft sand and pale taupe palette. Calm, airy, gentle mood suited for neutral or boy children's rooms.
